mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% in a month is associated with a short-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to immediate market anticipation of tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in a single month
regime_hint: FED Funds rate above 4.5% in tightening phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during such FEDFUNDS spikes (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) by more than 2% over a month predicts a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS exceeding the threshold (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (industrial production) index below 100 over a quarter is associated with a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as weak manufacturing demand reduces investor confidence.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 100 for 3 consecutive quarters with no significant 20-day forward return deviations (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST (home sales) of at least 5% are accompanied by a positive S&P 20-day forward return as rising housing demand signals economic resilience.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change > +5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: No positive 20-day forward return when HOUST meets the trigger (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained dual decline in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE (unemployment) for two consecutive months creates a reinforcing negative S&P 60-day forward return as policy tightening and labor market rigidity coincide.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < prev and UNRATE < prev for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Concurrent monetary tightening and labor market tightening
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such dual declines.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months in a labor market expansion regime, S&P 20-day forward returns turn positive due to increased hiring expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for three consecutive months and regime: labor expansion
failure_condition: No positive 20-day forward return when UNRATE meets the trigger (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (GDP) growth estimate below 2% in a quarter coincides with a negative S&P 60-day forward return as weak aggregate demand suppresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during such GDPC1 declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (money supply growth) above 6% in a month is followed by a positive S&P 20-day forward return as markets anticipate future inflationary pressure and potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day forward return when RSAFS spikes (p > 0.05).
